lines.text: Grand Theft Auto Six arrives on November the 19th.
lines.say: Grand Theft Auto Six arrives on November the nineteenth.

lines.text: And the whole series began as a mistake.
In 1995, a studio in Dundee, Scotland, started a game called Race and Chase.
lines.say: In nineteen ninety-five, a studio in Dundee, Scotland, started a game called Race and Chase.

lines.text: Cops chased robbers through a city. You could be either.
It was going nowhere. The publisher wanted to scrap it.
Then, one of its makers recalled, a bug sent the police cars berserk. Instead of driving round you, they tried to drive through you.
It was wonderful. So the bug stayed in.
The game came out in 1997, as Grand Theft Auto.
lines.say: The game came out in nineteen ninety-seven, as Grand Theft Auto.

lines.text: The sixth arrives 13 years after the fifth.
